ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1.8:1 ratio of high-intensity white pixels concentrated in the lobe centers versus low-intensity black pixels along the margins and trailing edge.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous white regions (RGB ~235,235,235) in the interior of both lobes. Black pigmentation (RGB ~15,15,15) borders the entire visible trailing edge and distal tips, with a dense mottled dark patch at the lower interior junction of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped median notch with a calculated internal angle of approximately 54 degrees and a vertical pixel depth representing roughly 25% of the visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration along the trailing edge; right lobe exhibits high-frequency, low-amplitude peaks (~5-8 pixels), while the left lobe shows deeper, jagged indentations (~12-18 pixels) particularly near the distal end.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges follow a sigmoidal path, displaying convexity at the distal tips transitioning to a concave curvature as the boundary approaches the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of high-intensity white pixel rosettes (barnacle colonization) localized on the outer distal tips. Multiple small, isolated dark pixel points (mottling) distributed across the white field of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two distinct dark linear pixel disruptions intersecting in an 'X' configuration on the lower-left lobe; faint parallel grey linear tracks (rake marks) are visible on the lower-mid region of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive epibiotic barnacle growth on the distal tips and irregular scarring along the trailing edge topography. Distinct overlapping linear scars on the lower left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: A singular, isolated dark circular spot (approximately 12 pixels in diameter) located in the upper-medial white field of the left lobe.
